Wingman's Hangar

It’s time for another edition of Wingman’s Hangar! Today Wingman will be talking to character animator Bryan Brewer. You can tune in live below at 11 AM CST (time zone converter) or check back afterwards and we’ll provide all the details after the broadcast!

Update: the live broadcast is over; check back Monday for a highlights video and more Star Citizen news!
